title: Menu Widget
description: A navigation menu: destinations, and groups of them that open, to any depth. Picking a destination dispatches `on.click` with its value in `detail.value`; a group's button only opens the group. For a button that opens a list of actions, use `menuButton`.

labelDef.description: The name of the menu's navigation landmark, such as "Main". Set it: two unnamed navigations on a page sound the same to a screen reader.

menuItem.description: A destination, or a group of items when it has `items`.

value.description: Unique in the menu. A destination sends it in the event's `detail.value`; `current` names an item by it.

icon.description: An icon before the label: a Material Icons ligature name.

disabled.description: Shows the item but stops the user picking it, or opening it for a group.

items.description: The items of a group. Its button opens and closes them, and emits no event.

orientationProp.description: `vertical` (the default): a column whose groups open in place. `horizontal`: a row whose groups open dropdowns, and that scrolls when it doesn't fit.

currentProp.description: The value of the current page's item: it is marked as the current page, and the groups that hold it start open. Interpolated, so `{{ $meta.view }}` follows the host's view.
